steps.title: Design system architecture
steps.instruction: Create a function named designSystemArchitecture that returns a basic architectural diagram description for a real-time system.
steps.hint: Think about the key components needed: data acquisition, processing, and response. Your function should return a string describing this architecture.
steps.expectedOutcome: A function that returns a string describing a real-time system architecture with data acquisition, processing, and response components.
successCriteria: The designSystemArchitecture function exists and returns a string describing the three main architectural components.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully designed the basic architecture for a real-time system with clear components for data flow.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your function returns a complete description of all three architectural components.
steps.feedbackWrong: Try again. Create a function named designSystemArchitecture that returns a string describing the system architecture.

steps.title: Implement timing constraints
steps.instruction: Create a function named implementTimingConstraints that defines timing constraints for system components, including worst-case execution time and response time requirements.
steps.hint: Define a function that specifies timing parameters like worst-case execution time (WCET) and response time for different system components.
steps.expectedOutcome: A function named implementTimingConstraints is defined with timing constraint specifications.
successCriteria: The implementTimingConstraints function is created and includes references to worst-case execution time and response time requirements.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully defined timing constraints for system components, which is essential for real-time system design.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've created a function, but make sure it includes both worst-case execution time and response time requirements.
steps.feedbackWrong: The function wasn't created correctly. Ensure you define a function named implementTimingConstraints that specifies timing constraints.

steps.feedbackWrong: The function isn't quite right. Create a function named 'designDataFlow' that returns a string describing data flow between components with timing and priority considerations.
